biographical_milestones.historical_context: Married Mary Todd in Springfield, Illinois.

biographical_milestones.event: Elected 16th President of the United States
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Won landmark 1860 presidential election triggering southern secession.

biographical_milestones.event: Outbreak of American Civil War (Fort Sumter)
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Confederate forces bombard Fort Sumter, launching full Civil War crisis.
Decisive re-election amidst ongoing wartime mobilization.

biographical_milestones.event: Assassination by John Wilkes Booth at Ford's Theatre
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Fatally shot by assassin at Ford's Theatre, dying the following morning.
